verdict.rationale: Chroma has its own headless, scriptable entry points. The official CLI can run a local server, it can be installed in a Python project, it can run locally or self-hosted, and an OpenAPI spec is published. All of these suit non-interactive automation. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI usage specifically. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, container or ephemeral server setup in pipelines), non-interactive CLI auth or flags documentation, independent hands-on reports of running Chroma in CI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
